items.title: How much specificity does delay actually cost?
items.description: Illustrative model, not a measured curve: represents how reliably a Situation can still be described in specific, checkable detail as days pass since the event — decaying fastest in the first few days, then leveling off toward vague, pattern-level recall. Drag the slider to see how quickly 'fresh and specific' turns into 'a general impression.'
items.compute: const specificityScore = Math.round(100 * Math.exp(-params.daysSinceEvent / 7)); return { specificityScore };
